Regarding the legal compliance of the provided paragraph: The actions described are compliant with legal standards. The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and the Fair Housing Act (FHA) require housing providers to make reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. This includes allowing service animals and, in many cases, emotional support animals, even in properties with a "no-pets" policy. By making these exceptions, the landlord is adhering to federal fair housing and disability rights laws.
